meaning:
κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as),
a quadrans (AV, farthing): Mat.5:26, Mrk.12:42.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: a small fraction of a denarius

elsewhere.note: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.
A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
